settings.reason: Heroicons 'cog-6-tooth' is the standard settings/gear icon; preferred over 'cog' and 'cog-8-tooth' for its cleaner design

sliders.reason: Heroicons 'adjustments-horizontal' represents horizontal sliders/adjustments; direct match for settings sliders

theme.reason: Heroicons 'swatch' represents color/theme selection; best available match for theme/palette since Heroicons has no 'palette' icon

light-mode.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'sun' icon for light mode

dark-mode.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'moon' icon for dark mode

accessibility.reason: Heroicons does not have an accessibility/wheelchair icon; confirmed via GitHub discussion #473 that this was requested but not added

plugin.reason: Heroicons 'puzzle-piece' represents plugin/extension; standard metaphor for extensions

webhook.reason: Heroicons does not have a webhook or API endpoint icon; no satisfactory match in the ~316 icon set

globe.reason: Heroicons 'globe-alt' is a wireframe globe icon; best match for world/public/language. Also available: 'globe-americas', 'globe-europe-africa', 'globe-asia-australia'

desktop.reason: Direct match; Heroicons uses 'computer-desktop' for desktop monitor

laptop.reason: Heroicons does not have a dedicated laptop icon; 'computer-desktop' is for monitors only and would be misleading for laptop

mobile.reason: Direct match; Heroicons uses 'device-phone-mobile' for smartphone/mobile device

tablet.reason: Direct match; Heroicons uses 'device-tablet' for tablet device

keyboard.reason: Heroicons does not have a keyboard icon

cpu.reason: Direct match; Heroicons uses 'cpu-chip' for processor/chip

storage.reason: Heroicons 'circle-stack' (stacked discs) is commonly used to represent storage/database; closest match for hard drive/disk storage

usb.reason: Heroicons does not have a USB icon

cast.reason: Heroicons does not have a cast/chromecast/airplay icon

terminal.reason: Direct match; Heroicons uses 'command-line' for terminal/console

database.reason: Heroicons 'circle-stack' (stacked discs) is the standard database icon representation

server.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'server' icon. Also available: 'server-stack' for multiple servers

cloud-upload.reason: Heroicons uses 'cloud-arrow-up' for cloud upload; renamed from v1's 'cloud-upload'

cloud-download.reason: Heroicons uses 'cloud-arrow-down' for cloud download; renamed from v1's 'cloud-download'

bug.reason: Heroicons uses 'bug-ant' for bug/issue; the icon depicts an ant/bug shape

git.reason: Heroicons does not have any git/branch/version-control icons; no brand or developer-tool-specific icons

network.reason: Heroicons does not have a dedicated network topology icon

wifi.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'wifi' icon for WiFi signal

bluetooth.reason: Heroicons does not have a Bluetooth icon

power.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'power' icon for power on/off

battery.reason: Heroicons has battery icons (battery-0, battery-50, battery-100); using 'battery-100' as the default full battery representation

tool.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'wrench' icon for single tool/fix

tools.reason: Heroicons 'wrench-screwdriver' shows crossed wrench and screwdriver; perfect match for tools/toolbox

barcode.reason: Heroicons does not have a barcode icon

random.reason: Heroicons does not have a dice or random icon

history.reason: Heroicons has 'clock' but no dedicated history/restore icon; 'clock' is a loose semantic match but commonly used for history. Considered 'arrow-path' (circular arrows) as an alternative for restore/refresh semantics

rain.reason: Heroicons does not have rain or weather-specific icons beyond sun, moon, and cloud

storm.reason: Heroicons 'bolt' (lightning bolt) is the closest match for storm/lightning; no cloud-lightning combo exists

snow.reason: Heroicons does not have a snowflake or snow icon

wind.reason: Heroicons does not have a wind icon

temperature.reason: Heroicons does not have a thermometer or temperature icon

water.reason: Heroicons does not have a droplet or water/humidity icon

coffee.reason: Heroicons does not have a coffee cup or mug icon

infinity.reason: Heroicons does not have an infinity symbol icon

eco.reason: Heroicons does not have a leaf or eco/nature icon

hexagon.reason: Heroicons does not have a hexagon shape icon

triangle.reason: Heroicons does not have a triangle shape icon; 'exclamation-triangle' exists but is a warning symbol, not a geometric shape

google.reason: Heroicons does not include any brand icons

android.reason: Heroicons does not include any brand icons

sparkles.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'sparkles' icon, commonly used for AI/magic features

wand.reason: Heroicons does not have a magic wand icon

bot.reason: Heroicons does not have a robot or bot icon

notifications.reason: Direct match; Heroicons 'bell' is the standard notifications/alerts icon. Also available: 'bell-alert', 'bell-slash', 'bell-snooze'

email.reason: Heroicons uses 'envelope' for email; renamed from v1's 'mail'. Also available: 'envelope-open'

inbox.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'inbox' icon. Also available: 'inbox-arrow-down', 'inbox-stack'

phone.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'phone' icon for phone calls. Also available: 'phone-arrow-down-left', 'phone-arrow-up-right', 'phone-x-mark'

contacts.reason: Heroicons 'identification' (ID card icon) is the closest match for contacts/address book; no dedicated address book icon exists

lock.reason: Heroicons uses 'lock-closed' for locked/secure state; v2 renamed 'lock' to 'lock-closed'

unlock.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'lock-open' for unlocked state

security.reason: Heroicons 'shield-exclamation' represents security/protection with alert; chosen over plain 'shield-check' to distinguish from 'secure'

secure.reason: Direct match; Heroicons 'shield-check' represents verified/secure with checkmark

key.reason: Direct match; Heroicons has 'key' icon for key/password/access
